note: LILYGO T-Dongle-C5, the LayerTime Node for Slice 1. It runs the Recon engine and serves the tactix over LayerTime Link; it has no operator UI beyond a status LCD, one LED, and one button. Drafted in Slice 1 Increment 0: nothing is verified yet, so every effective value is the DeviceCapabilities default and intent is in target. A field's effective value changes only when its status becomes verified on the board.

displayClass.evidence: 0.96 in ST7735 80 x 160 status LCD: github.com/Xinyuan-LilyGO/T-Dongle-C5 readme.md and include/pin_config.h (commit 239a993). Colour, but too small for LayerTime screens; it shows status text only.

displayShape.evidence: Same source: 80 x 160 panel, used in landscape 160 x 80.

touch.evidence: No touch controller on the schematic (hardware/T-Dongle-C5 V1.1.pdf)

buttons.evidence: KEY1 (BOOT) on GPIO28 with 10 k pull-up R16, schematic V1.1; strapping pin per ESP32-C5 datasheet Table 3-3. Read as an input after boot in devices/lilygo-layerwand/src/C5BringUp.cpp.

vibration.evidence: No vibration motor on the schematic. Alerts use the APA102 LED (U3, GPIO4 clock / GPIO5 data) and the LCD.

gps.evidence: No GNSS on the schematic. Position comes from the tactix in later slices.

altitude.evidence: No barometer or GNSS on the schematic

nativeMaps.evidence: No cartography on a 160 x 80 status LCD

removableStorage.evidence: A microSD slot exists (SPI, CS GPIO23, sharing the LCD bus; D0 is strapping pin GPIO7). Slice 1 decision D5: not used.

localWifiMonitor.evidence: ESP32-C5 sniffer mode: docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/esp32c5/api-guides/wifi-driver/wifi-modes.html. Proven for LayerTime in Slice 1 Increment 2A.

localBleMonitor.evidence: NimBLE on the ESP32-C5: docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/esp32c5/api-guides/ble/overview.html; NimBLE-Arduino 2.3.0+ lists ESP32C5. Proven for LayerTime in Slice 1 Increment 2A.

externalRecon.evidence: The C5 is the Recon engine and the LayerTime Link server, not a client of another node

meshUi.evidence: No mesh on the C5 in Slice 1 (LT-ARCH-001 rule 6); mesh is Slice 2 through Android

localMeshtasticRadio.evidence: No LoRa radio on the board; LT-ARCH-001 rule 6

androidBridge.evidence: The Android bridge is Slice 2 and serves the tactix, not the C5
